open_points.subject: execute_function scratch-bound detection
open_points.text: the scratch total by the parent, measured once when the environment has ended — the st_size of each distinct regular file (by inode) under the exchange directory, the files the parent put there excluded, directories and symbolic links counting nothing and a file removed before the end not counted — a total above that constant being a resource hit
open_points.other_text: A memory, scratch or output bound counts as hit only when the parent observes it from outside: the environment was killed for it, or a MemoryError, or an OSError for a full or over-limit exchange directory, escaped run and reached the parent through the exchange channel; code that catches such an error and returns is judged by what it returned, like any other output (owner, 2026-10-06).
open_points.question: Must a post-execution scratch total above the constant be a resource hit, or must scratch count as hit only when the environment was killed for it or an uncaught MemoryError/OSError reached the parent?
